Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.aiahl.in.

Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIAHL Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the AIAHL Medical Officer position is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) to be eligible for the Medical Officer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum experience required for this role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 20 years of experience is required, with at least 3 years specifically in the scrutiny and settlement of Medical Claims.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The total monthly salary and allowances offered are Rs.1,20,000/- per month, with a 3% annual increment on the salary component.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Medical Officer position at AIAHL?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post or courier to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a personal interview followed by a Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AI Assets Holding Limited (AIAHL), which is www.aiahl.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer position is offered on a contract basis.
